method: Unlit Babylon renders, registered camera matrices; edited material details projected onto the existing geometry. Generated detail is inferred, not measured.
frontPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: camera-projected base-color texture for an existing 3D game model. Edit this EXACT 2048 square render in place. Restore high-resolution surface detail only: crisp irregular masonry joints and fractured stone, fine long weathered wood grain and charred cracks on all beams and the broken waterwheel, distinct worn roof shingles, individually readable courtyard stones, dry sparse ochre grass, cold dark stream. Serious grounded dark fantasy, hand-painted ink and flat wash, slate/soot/umber/ochre. Keep EXACT camera, crop, every silhouette, building, beam, wheel spoke, hole, door, hatch, rock and object position. Pixel registration is crucial: do not move, add, delete or straighten geometry. Keep background solid dark gray and exactly the same. Do not add shadows, highlights, lighting effects or haze: this is an unlit albedo texture repaint. Preserve current average surface colors, improve fine detail locally. No new props, people, text or labels. Output at 2048x2048 or highest supported native square resolution.
